findings.title: Planner token budget exceeded
findings.detail: The monolithic paste exceeds configured planner token budgets; reviewers received an explicit boundary message listing truncated offsets instead of silent condensation.

findings.title: Partial subgraph ingest
findings.detail: Only the first and last template shards hydrated into topology services—middle ARM sections were omitted under deterministic truncation so blast radius stays knowingly incomplete.

findings.title: Partial cost projection
findings.detail: Cost agents flagged partial SKU coverage and paused monthly projections until chunk replay completes—avoid trusting headline savings numbers.

findings.title: Evidence completeness caveat
findings.detail: Compliance attestations should cite which artifact spans were skipped during truncation to avoid implying full-map review occurred.
